rationale: Build on the staged reverse-tail recurrence baseline instead of another scalar sweep. This adds a compile-stable late curriculum that gradually refreshes the frozen decoder-output anchor toward the evolving recurrent state before each reverse tail replay. The hypothesis is that the best family wants some anchor staleness early for stability, but a modest late refresh should reduce mismatch between the recurrent carry path and the final int8 roundtrip model without adding parameters or export bytes.
title: Late Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh Mix
